title: Practice Swing
paragraphs: “Where’s Gaelion?”
“Just in case, can you stay in the rear… and make sure they can’t escape? Also, prepare a breath attack that can induce status ailments if necessary.”
“It’s a dragon’s territory, so it’s fine! If we take this chance, Gaelion can make this place his nest, and I’ll get the breath ready!”
“Either way… let’s hear them out. We also need to determine whether he’s a summoned Hero or not.”
“Worst case, we capture him alive. Even if people who know his face say he’s a different person, we should take him back and investigate with magic or whatever means necessary.”
“Well, let’s start by talking. For now… in situations like this, the usual thing to do is…”

Father took the lead and approached Cola while clapping his hands. Ah, I see, he’s trying to praise them to lower their hostility. Come to think of it, Cola’s pigs did crave praise. If we compliment them, negotiations might go smoothly.
“Bubu!?”
“Who goes there!”
Clapping his hands, we Heroes slowly walked toward the light.
“Still, defeating the dragon that ruled this place is quite an impressive feat.”

However… I feel like we’re appearing like villains from a story, just like Father mentioned before. To be honest, it feels like we’re giving off the impression that we’re here to snatch away their treasure.
“You guys… the Heroes from earlier.”
Cola heightened his guard at our approach.
“Ah, I don’t want you to misunderstand, but since you defeated the dragon here and won the treasure, we have no intention of taking it. Fortunately, we’re not hurting for money.”
“However, can I ask you a few questions? Depending on your answers, I’d like you to come with us.”
Cola and the pigs did not lower their guard. Well, it’s time for Father’s negotiation skills to shine.

“We were also exploring this place and saw that someone had already gotten here first, so we decided to wait and see what happened. Honestly, we had no intention of interfering, and if you had won normally, we wouldn’t have shown ourselves.”

Cola exchanged glances with the pigs. Father and the others also sensed the tension and were on alert. To be safe, I minimized any openings on my end as well. If a fight breaks out, I’ll take them down instantly.

“I don’t want you to misunderstand, but… we’re not looking for a fight… However, Yuta-kun, was it? You haven’t lowered your stance since earlier, ready to attack at any moment. Is that a sign of hostility?”
“Naofumi, don’t you think they’re ready for a fight? They seem intent on silencing us now that we know their true identity.”
“Indeed, even though we’re fellow Heroes, it doesn’t seem like they’re willing to talk, does it?”
“Let’s not jump to conclusions,” Father told Cola gently, as if soothing a child.

“First question. That weapon—is it one of the Seven Star Weapons, a Projectile Weapon? Next question, are you a summoned Hero who’s disguising yourself with magic or some other means and refusing to fight against the Waves?”
“Bububububuhi!”
Almost simultaneously with the pig’s cry, Ren and Itsuki drew their weapons. I don’t know what they said, but I pointed my spear at them as well.
“Witnesses must be eliminated! No matter who they are!”
And with that, Cola charged at us. He swung his Projectile Weapon back with full force, ready to throw.
“Air Strike Throw! Second Throw! Dritte—”
“Motoyasu-kun! Just in case, use that!”
That referred to the confiscation of the vassal weapon. If Cola was in possession of the Projectile Weapon through illegal means, like Takt or that ghostly Crimson Swine, we could confiscate it.
“Understood! The Love Hunter commands! O vassal weapon, heed the call of the Love Hunter, break free from the foolish shackles of power, and awaken!”
At my words, the Projectile Weapon in Cola’s hand began to glow faintly.
“What!?”
“I hereby strip you of your qualification as a vassal!”
And just like that, the Projectile Weapon effortlessly flew toward us and hovered in the air.
…In other words, these guys are the same as Takt.
“Buhii!?”
Cola and the pigs froze, letting out cries of shock. Their reaction was exactly the same as Takt’s when his qualification for the Seven Star Weapon was revoked.
“I can understand wanting to hide the fact that you’re a summoned victim and not wanting to be exposed… but…”
Father stared at the floating Projectile Weapon and his eyes hardened with scrutiny.
“The answer to my first question is clear. This is the Projectile Weapon of the Seven Star Weapons. Now for the next question… you’re not the rightful owner, are you?”

Exactly. I explained it to Father and the others. If the one wielding the weapon is the rightful owner, even a Four Holy Hero’s command to revoke it wouldn’t work that easily. Yet, the fact that it was released with a simple command means that Cola is controlling it through some kind of forceful and illegitimate method, just like Takt.
“Buhii! Buhihihi!”

The pigs squealed and charged at us. Shall I slaughter them? Before I could ready my spear, Ren and Itsuki had already counterattacked. Ren used his sword to knock the pigs away, while Itsuki fired warning shots, sending bullets at their feet repeatedly to force them back.

“Why did you take Yuta’s trump card!? Give it back… This is a Hero’s weapon, a Seven Star Weapon, and he’s the rightful owner. Don’t pretend like you don’t know what that means,” Father responded with a sigh of exasperation.
These guys are similar to Takt in every possible way.
“No matter what, we can’t afford to lose here!”
“Uh, listen…”
Cola drew a fancy-looking sword from his waist and charged at us.
“You may have some basic knowledge, but your footwork is too shallow!”
Ren blocked Cola’s sword head-on and countered with a slash.
“Guh… damn it!”
“Buhii!”
A flash of light burst between Ren and Cola. It seems one of the pigs cast a spell to assist him. To avoid the magic, Ren shoved Cola away and retreated.
“I’ll admit, your stance and attacks have a certain sharpness to them. But… that kind of movement wouldn’t even work against a computer.”
“You can’t expect everyone to understand things by Ren standards…”
Indeed. I don’t really understand these so-called computers from VR or whatever.
“Damn it! Are you telling me I can’t win with the status I built through practice swings!?”
“P-Practice swings!?”
Ren turned to me and Father with a dumbfounded expression.
Practice swings… what is that supposed to mean? I don’t quite get it.
I’ve been thinking this for a while, but isn’t this guy living in a completely different world than us?
“Did… did he just say practice swings?”
“Ah… wasn’t there something about training raising abilities beyond the level correction? I think Éclair mentioned that once. Maybe that’s what he’s talking about?”
“You can’t beat a real opponent in battle with a game-like mindset!”

Ren snapped without thinking. Honestly, I’d like to say those same words to the Ren from before. Well, even back then, Ren was obsessed with level, but he never said anything about practice swings. But this Cola guy… isn’t he just an idiot?
“Umm… Naofumi-san, doesn’t this remind you of something?”
“Yeah. That one game where you max out your stats by punching a wall hundreds of times before progressing.”
“I’ve heard of that too. If that logic applies, I suppose his attack power would increase.”
Father and Itsuki stared at Cola with half-lidded eyes. They’re completely exasperated.
“Even so, wouldn’t that only affect physical strength? It wouldn’t improve his technique. Against Ren, if he can’t land a hit, it’s meaningless.”
“And how much would a regular person have to train to match a Hero’s strength through sheer power?”
With the Heroes’ enhancements, our abilities are over twelve times higher.

Even if his strength increased through practice swings, how long would it take to catch up? Besides, Cola has a slim build. Gaining strength through practice swings… it reminds me of that sister doing push-ups. Even with all that effort, she only managed to gain a slight increase in ability.

And yet this guy thinks practice swings are enough… Isn’t he completely underestimating things? Even I’ve gained a decent amount of strength from my adventures, and playing seriously with the Filolials has naturally increased my physical strength. So, I’m not saying practice swings or training are useless.

But… he’s nowhere near doing enough of it, is he? Moreover, even Ren does practice swings every day. Whenever he finds free time, he practices not only swings but also strength training, and he even spars with Father and Itsuki. Stat-wise, Ren is superior, but he also trains with Éclair, who surpasses him in skill. Sometimes he even asks me to help. Lately, he’s been teaching swordsmanship to Mole while learning himself.
“Are you mocking me!?”
With an extremely irritated expression, Ren yelled at Cola. Ren admires strength. He must feel like he’s being made fun of.
